hooks.text: 出牌直接推动股价，Greed会同时放大收益与风险，玩家必须选择何时套现锁定利润
hooks.excerpt: Play your hand to move prices, controlling how the market reacts. Greed acts like rocket fuel, accelerating gains and risk. Only you can decide when to cash out and secure your profits.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每个交易日之间进入Aftermarket选牌，收益常与副作用绑定，最终只有自建牌组决定开盘走势
hooks.excerpt: Between market days, you enter the Aftermarket to draft cards from different pools, often taking upside alongside risk. Some cards strengthen your deck. Others weaken it. When the market opens, the deck you built is the only thing shaping price movement.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 不同投机角色拥有专属起始牌组和特殊机制，迫使玩家尝试不同市场策略
hooks.excerpt: Each character is a maverick trader with a unique approach to the market. Get to know their quirks as you play. Their starting decks and special mechanics open up new possibilities, encouraging strategies you might not try otherwise.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 核心循环满足且存在多种获胜路径。

excerpts.excerpt: The gameplay loop is satisfying, there are multiple approaches to winning
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
